$comment: Peppol providers (digitálny poštár) offered in the connection wizard (04-peppol.md § 4.2). Updated by a release, without code changes. Tariffs as published by the providers on checkedAt; re-check before each release. null means not confirmed yet. api: AVAILABLE | ANNOUNCED | NONE | UNKNOWN. sapiSk: YES | ANNOUNCED | NO | UNKNOWN. adapter: the client adapter the app uses (sapi-sk, or the id of a native adapter), null while no API connection is possible. segment: SMALL (connect directly), ERP (used by larger firms through their ERP), FOREIGN (accredited abroad, for firms invoicing in several countries). The gateway keeps its own server-side copy of the hosts as the proxy allowlist.
sourcesNote: baseUrl, pricingUrl and sapiSk are filled only from the provider's own documentation or SDK listed in sources; everything else stays null until confirmed.
